# HABITAS — Ultra-Luxury Ocean Suites & Villas

> Habitas is an ultra-luxury coastal sanctuary located on the pristine Sindh coast (24°48'N, 67°01'E). The property comprises three private oceanfront architectural residences: Suite 301, Villa 204, and Pavilion 102.

## Core Resources

- [Residences & Suites](https://habittas.web.app/suites): Detailed room architectural specifications, private infinity pools, dimensions, and nightly rates.
- [Reservation Engine](https://habittas.web.app/reserve): Direct booking system with transparent 30% Safepay advance deposit verification and flexible arrival dates.
- [Guest Self-Service Portal](https://habittas.web.app/my-stay): Digital keycard, room temperature and lighting presets, dining room-service ordering, and real-time folio accounting.
- [Staff PMS Portal](https://habittas.web.app/login): Aptech-certified front desk terminal for room check-ins, guest folios, and housekeeping status.

## Optional

- [Agent Catalog](https://habittas.web.app/ai-catalog.json): Machine-readable schema describing resort service endpoints for autonomous AI agents.
